card.name: "With" after co-use or interaction nouns
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after nouns like concomitant treatment, coadministration, concurrent use or interaction studies, before the name of a second drug. Also fires on a few similar linking words such as "over" or "and" between two parties.

modes.label: With after co-use
modes.description: "With" follows a term for using drugs together and introduces the other drug.
